title_ar: سماحة العلامة الشيخ الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء يخطب في الحجاج الموريتانيين بعرفات
title_en: His Eminence the Learned Sheikh al-Dedew, President of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, Preaches to the Mauritanian Pilgrims at Arafat
body_ar:
ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء خطبة عرفة لحجة هذا العام 1432هـ، في مخيم الحجاج الموريتانيين حيث وعظ الحجاج وذكرهم ببعض فوائد الحج وأحكامه، ومنة الله عليهم بأن وفقهم لتأدية مناسكه.

وقام الشيخ خلال أيام الحج بعدة محاضرات في إطار الأنشطة الدعوية التي يقوم بها كل عام في موسم الحج، من ضمنها:

محاضرة ألقاها في حملة طيبة القطرية، ولقاء مع قناة المجد، ومحاضرة في مخيم البعثة الموريتانية في منى، هذا بالإضافة إلى مناشط أخرى دعوية دأب الشيخ على القيام بها كل سنة في موسم الحج والعمرة.

للإطلاع على خطبة عرفة مع تلخيصها اضغط هنا.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, delivered the Arafah sermon for this year's hajj, 1432 AH, in the camp of the Mauritanian pilgrims, where he admonished the pilgrims and reminded them of some of the benefits of the hajj and of its rulings, and of God's favour upon them in granting them the means to perform its rites.

During the days of the hajj the Sheikh gave several lectures as part of the daʿwah activities he undertakes every year in the hajj season, among them:

a lecture he gave with the Qatari Taybah pilgrimage group; an interview with the al-Majd channel; and a lecture in the camp of the Mauritanian mission at Mina — besides other daʿwah activities the Sheikh has made a practice of undertaking every year in the season of the hajj and of the lesser pilgrimage (ʿumrah).

flags.arabic: حيث وعظ الحجاج وذكرهم ببعض فوائد الحج وأحكامه
flags.context: the only description of the sermon's content in the whole record
options: display as an announcement that the sermon took place, with the sermon itself behind the link
flags.note: critical_for_display. The record states that the Sheikh reminded the pilgrims of some of the rulings of the hajj and gives not one of them. A reader who meets a page headed 'the Arafah sermon' and finds this text under it will take a two-sentence announcement for the sermon. The sermon and a summary of it are at /index.php/fikh/fikh-mawasim.html?view=media&id=1573, and the record must point there rather than stand in for it.

options: the plain of Arafat near Mecca
flags.note: Here عرفات is the plain near Mecca: the record is dated in the days after the hajj of 1432, names the sermon as خطبة عرفة, and places it in the Mauritanian pilgrims' camp, with a further lecture at Mina. This is the opposite reading from records 754 and 756 in this same span, where عرفات is the moughataa of Nouakchott. The two senses are not distinguished in the Arabic and the corpus must not let the site conflate them.

flags.context: one of the venues of his hajj lectures
flags.note: A حملة in the hajj context is an organised pilgrimage group run by a licensed operator, not a 'campaign' in the ordinary English sense; the false friend is worth avoiding across the corpus. The operator's own English spelling of طيبة is not known from the record.

options: keep the hijri year alone, as the source has it
add the Gregorian year in brackets
flags.note: The source gives the hijri year only. Kept as given; the hajj of 1432 fell in early November 2011, consistent with the record's timestamp. Whether to add Gregorian equivalents throughout is a house decision for the corpus.

translator_notes: A short news report. It reports that a sermon was given and summarises none of it, so no ruling appears anywhere in the record and the five-rulings mapping of style guide section 3 is not engaged.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date and is not evidence of when the report was written.
أحكام is rendered 'rulings' in its ordinary plural sense here; no individual ruling is named, so no term of the five-rulings table is engaged.

The closing 'to see the Arafah sermon with its summary, click here' is the site's navigation furniture; preserved in body_ar, recorded in source_download_link, omitted from body_en. Note that the link is said to carry both the sermon and a summary of it; if that summary is itself a separate record elsewhere in the corpus, the two should be cross-linked.
Compare records 419 and 420, which report the same annual occasion for the hajj of the previous year.
